data.exact_reserve_text:
Over/(under) provisions for claims at the beginning of the year as compared with net payments and provisions at the end of the year in respect of prior years' claims are as follows:

Favourable prior year loss development of GBP 0.2 million was recorded in 2022 compared to favourable development of GBP 8.6 million in the prior calendar year. In the current calendar year, the favourable loss development was driven primarily by lower emergence of claims of certain lines of business than previously anticipated.
data.standardized_narrative: The gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse movement (strengthening) of approximately GBP 34.2m for underwriting years 2020 and earlier, driven by increases concentrated in several older underwriting years (notably around 2017-2018). By contrast, the narrative in the notes reports a small favourable prior year loss development of GBP 0.2m (net of reinsurance). This discrepancy reflects that the reported narrative figure is net of reinsurance while the triangle yields a gross prior year movement; the extracted prior-year-development above is derived from the gross claims development table.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross prior-year movement extracted from the gross claims development triangle (page 43). The notes (page 36) state a small favourable prior year development of GBP 0.2m but that figure is presented net of reinsurance; the triangle provides a gross view and yields a net adverse (strengthening) of ~GBP 34.2m for underwriting years <=2020. The movement note in the accounts appears to only present net amounts by class; therefore gross movement was computed from the triangle. No specific named events affecting prior years are clearly identified in the narrative; no RITC disclosures appear to invalidate the triangle. Lob-level prior year movements were only provided in aggregated groups (Commercial / Specialty) net of reinsurance; gross per-LOB movements were not available, so lob_movements is empty.
